requirements.annual_target_note: ISC2 states 120 per three-year cycle as the binding requirement and suggests ~40/year as pacing. Registrar treats 40/yr as PACE GUIDANCE, not a hard floor, and says so on every report.

submission.note: Report as earned through the ISC2 member portal; all credits must be earned and posted by cycle end (plus grace).

credentials.unit_note: ISC2 calls one credit a CPE credit; one hour of qualifying activity is one CPE.
credentials.verification_note: Totals, group split, AMF and the 90-day grace read from the ISC2 member-policies and AMF pages (re-verified 2026-10-20): 120 per three years, Group A 90, Group A or B 30, 40/yr suggested only, USD 135 AMF, 90-day grace, and ISSAP/ISSEP/ISSMP CPEs counting toward CISSP. Rollover terms are unverified; see rollover below.

cross_credential.note: Renewing with a higher-level CompTIA certification renews CySA+ outright and waives the fee. That is a single-activity renewal path, not credit carryover.

fees.due_note: Payable by the certification expiration date. CompTIA also sells CE tokens ($25/$50, non-expiring). An annual-thirds figure of $50/yr circulates in third-party guides; CompTIA's own fee page states the three-year amount, which is what is encoded.

credentials.grace_note: After expiry the holder can activate a 30-day grace period to pay CE fees and/or submit CEUs already earned inside the cycle. No new activities count, and there are no extensions (help.comptia.org article 13922681550228, read 2026-10-20).
credentials.name: CySA+

requirements.annual_target_note: CompTIA sets no annual floor; 20/yr is Registrar's even-pacing figure only.
requirements.relevance_rule: At least 50% of an activity's content must relate to the CySA+ exam objectives.

submission.note: Upload CEUs to the CompTIA CE portal as earned; fee due by the certification expiration date.

credentials.unit_note: CompTIA calls one credit a CEU. Rates are NOT uniformly one-per-hour — creating instructional materials is 2/hour, a college class is a flat 10, a book is a flat award.
credentials.verification_note: Total (60/3yr) from CompTIA's CySA+ renewal page. Per-bucket rates and caps from CompTIA's own category pages: work-experience, publishing, it-industry-participation, training-and-higher-education. CE fee from CompTIA's continuing-education-renewal-fees page. Re-verified 2026-10-20 on www.comptia.org: total 60 (Earn CEUs table), fee USD 150 per three years, 50% relevance rule, work experience 3/yr capped at 9, college/ACE course 10 per class, teaching 1/hr and materials 2/hr all unchanged. Corrected from today's CySA+ columns: blog cap 12 -> 18, article cap 12 -> 18, book 60 -> 50 (value and cap), teaching cap unknown -> 30, materials cap unknown -> 30, conference cap none -> 15 (own bucket), grace 0 -> 30 days. The old source URL (renew-options/renewing-cysa-multiple) was not re-read; the totals table is on the Earn CEUs page.

requirements.annual_target_note: EC-Council publishes no hard annual floor, but credits are earned and REGISTERED on a calendar-year basis, so an unregistered year is a real loss. 40/yr is even pacing across the 120.

submission.note: Credits are earned per calendar year (1 January - 31 December) and MUST be registered by 1 February of the following year. A missed window is the single sharpest edge in this portfolio.

credentials.unit_note: EC-Council now calls one credit a CPE credit (formerly ECE; the policy page and its URL were renamed). Most awards are flat per-item, not per-hour.
credentials.verification_note: Total, cycle, the January-to-December earning window with the 1-February registration deadline, the $80 annual membership fee and the full activity/credit table read directly from EC-Council's ECE policy page. Re-verified 2026-10-20: cert.eccouncil.org/ece-policy.html now redirects to cpe-policy.html, whose displayed text says CPE throughout (the ECE wording is still in the HTML but hidden by CSS). Unit corrected ECE -> CPE. 120 per certification per three-year window, earning 1 Jan - 31 Dec with registration by 1 Feb, every credit value encoded below, and the USD 80 annual CE fee (continuing-education-fees page) unchanged.

requirements.annual_target_note: UMD sets no interim reporting and no annual floor; the whole 100 is due at the end of the four years. 25/yr is Registrar's pacing figure only.

submission.note: Single renewal submission at the end of the four-year window; no interim reporting required.

credentials.unit_note: UMD calls one credit a Professional Development Unit.
credentials.verification_note: Four-year window, 100 PDUs, the 60/40 C-InT split, the per-category maxima and the $500 recertification fee read directly from UMD's maintain-certification page. NOTE: GCITP IS A UMD CREDENTIAL, NOT GIAC/SANS — the acronym resemblance is a common source of error. Re-verified 2026-10-20 on gcitp.umd.edu (maintain page, PDU reference table, candidate handbook): 4 years, 100 PDUs, 60% C-InT minimum, 40% other maximum, special projects 45, USD 500 / 650 unchanged. The name Global Counter-Insider Threat Professional matches UMD's PDU table and handbook. Teaching, mentoring and workshops corrected 1 -> 3 PDUs per contact hour (own bucket). Not modelled: the 45-PDU per-event cap, the 40-PDU cap on non-GCITP certifications, and the fixed per-item values for publications (see publications cap_note).
